Markets.title: Hotter producer prices strengthen bets on a Fed rate hike
Markets.summary: Rising US producer prices increased expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates by a quarter-point next week. Meanwhile, renewed Middle East conflict and rising oil prices are further complicating the inflation outlook.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian markets ended higher as the Sensex and Nifty reversed losses during the closing auction to snap a three-session decline. Cautious sentiment persisted amid crude oil above $102, weak global cues, and rising yields.

Markets.title: Will Bitcoin touch $400,000 by 2030? Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong answers
Markets.summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong predicts that Bitcoin could reach $400,000 by 2030. He believes the cryptocurrency has passed its market bottom and will be driven upward by upcoming halving events and regulatory updates.

Markets.title: Copper falls after report of White House hesitancy over tariff plan
Markets.summary: Copper prices fell on the London Metal Exchange and COMEX following reports that the White House is hesitating on potential tariff plans. This hesitation stems from concerns that tariffs could increase manufacturing expenses.

Markets.title: ECB raises interest rates as Iran war fans inflation fears
Markets.summary: The European Central Bank raised interest rates for the second time this year to combat inflation driven by high energy costs and geopolitical factors. Policymakers took this action because inflation is expected to remain above target through 2028, despite ongoing economic resilience.

Markets.title: American Eagle shares slump on flat margin outlook, weakness in namesake brand
Markets.summary: American Eagle shares dropped significantly after the retailer forecast stagnant gross margins for the upcoming quarter due to sluggish demand and excess inventory. Although the Aerie brand showed promise, it could not offset the ongoing weakness in the namesake American Eagle label.

Geo-Political.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
Geo-Political.summary: Yemen's Houthi rebels have reportedly seized the strategic Red Sea port of Mokha. This capture brings the Iran-backed group closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait, which is a key shipping route.

Geo-Political.title: Pilot warned Amazon cargo plane going too fast before deadly crash, data shows
Geo-Political.summary: Flight data shows that one pilot warned the other about the Amazon cargo plane's excessive speed just before it crashed. Despite this warning and blaring alarms, the crew's response was uneven.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says every adult American will get $5,000 if Republicans win midterms
Geo-Political.summary: US President Trump promised that every adult American will receive $5,000 if Republicans win the midterm elections. However, he provided no details regarding how the plan would be funded or implemented.

Geo-Political.title: Israel's Netanyahu to sue newspaper over claim UAE warned him of 7 October attack
Geo-Political.summary: The paper said it stood by its reporting, after publishing extracts from a book where the claim appears.

Geo-Political.title: Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China
Geo-Political.summary: A fire broke out on a cargo ship in eastern China, resulting in 25 deaths. Seventeen of the 42 people on board were successfully evacuated.

Geo-Political.title: More than 20 children feared dead in DR Congo school fire
Geo-Political.summary: More than 20 children are feared dead following a fire and subsequent stampede at two schools in the eastern city of Bukavu in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The rebel-held city experienced the disaster as the students attempted to flee the flames.

Data & Insights.summary: At the upcoming BRICS summit, India aims to advance cooperation on trade, payments, energy security, and supply chains. Simultaneously, New Delhi must delicately manage its diplomatic relations with China, Russia, and the broader Global South.

India.title: Sacked Driver 'Raids' Ex-Employer Over Unpaid Salary, Tax Officials Help Him
India.summary: An unemployed driver arranged for tax officials to raid his former employer after he was dismissed without six months of unpaid salary. Police reported that the disgruntled 37-year-old ex-employee orchestrated the operation to target the businessperson.

India.title: 'Can't Shout At Judges': Supreme Court Pulls Up Law Official In Contempt Case
India.summary: The Supreme Court reprimanded a law official for arguing that the High Court was responsible for failing to fill 179 fast-track court posts in Maharashtra. The court warned the official that he cannot shout at judges and told him to repent.

India.title: 41 Structures Razed, 61 Properties Sealed In Delhi After Hostel Collapse
India.summary: Authorities in Delhi demolished 41 structures and sealed 61 properties following a hostel collapse. The civic body also issued 32 show-cause notices and three demolition orders during the operation.

India.title: 101-Year-Old Freedom Fighter, Mistakenly Declared Dead, Fights for Pension
India.summary: The Fatehabad administration mistakenly declared 101-year-old freedom fighter Nadar Singh dead three years ago. He is now fighting the government to restore his official pension.

India.title: BRICS At 20: How Big It Is, And Why It Matters To India And The World
India.summary: The BRICS grouping is emerging as a more influential force in global affairs as countries redraw their strategic partnerships. This shift highlights the growing global and strategic importance of the bloc, which was once dismissed by former US President Donald Trump.

India.title: 'Villagers Stopped BJP Leaders': Politics Spirals Over Punjab Man's Suicide
India.summary: Punjab BJP chief Kewal Singh Dhillon's convoy was attacked amidst rising political tensions over a man's suicide. The BJP blamed AAP workers for the incident, while AAP stated that local villagers forced the politicians to leave.

General.title: Labour mayors in England vow to cap tourist tax at 5%
General.summary: Labour mayors in England have announced plans to cap a new tourist tax on overnight stays at 5%. This proposed levy has faced criticism from both the Conservative Party and Reform UK.

General.title: Oil, gas and borrowing costs surge as fears over Middle East escalate
General.summary: Oil prices jumped to $105 a barrel as escalation in the Middle East fueled fears of a prolonged conflict. This escalation also caused borrowing costs and natural gas prices to surge.

General.summary: The home secretary has instructed police to use all necessary powers to handle anti-migrant protests. This directive follows demonstrations that occurred in Dover and Portsmouth last weekend.

General.summary: Four people were injured in a London stabbing incident. Police subsequently arrested seven individuals and stated there is no wider threat to the public.

General.title: Drone display recreates the Twin Towers over New York City
General.summary: A drone display over New York City recreated the Twin Towers using 2,977 drones. Organisers stated that each drone represented a victim of the 9/11 attacks.
